title: WorldcoinPaymaster
tagline: WorldcoinPaymaster sponsors gas fees for Worldcoin verified users!
description:
Worldcoin paymaster lets users verified on Optimism testnet on Worldcoin to get transaction sponsored on the Base Testnet using a Paymaster

This project helps with sponsoring transactions of wallet who are bound to have human owners, basically fighting sybil resistance for gas sponsorship from Paymaster
how_its_made: User verify themselves on the Optimism testnet worldcoin (on-chain) and on verification a cross-chain call is made using Layerzero to Base testnet to create an EAS attestation which has all the information about the worldcoin on-chain verification which is then taken the EAS Schema Resolver which then adds the address to the allowlist in the paymaster which then can recognize whom to sponsor transactions for
